{"message":"I’m sorry you’re dealing with this — I can help. Since you’re not 100% sure the wallet is gone, the safest immediate option is to temporarily freeze both debit cards so new transactions are declined while you keep looking. If the cards are definitely lost/stolen, we should close them permanently and order replacements.

Quick summary of your options:
- Freeze (recommended now if you’re still searching): temporary, blocks new purchases and recurring charges; you can unfreeze later. Pending/authorized transactions may still post.
- Close (use if definitely lost/stolen): permanent deactivation; card cannot be reactivated and you’ll need replacement cards. Pending transactions can still post and refunds go to the linked checking account.

Extra protections and next steps I can offer:
- We can also check whether you have any Rho-Bank credit cards and offer to order replacements if they were in the wallet (this is a security precaution).
- We can enable a recurring-payments block for a card (blocks ALL recurring/subscription charges) if you want to prevent future subscription charges.
- Under Regulation E, reporting a lost/stolen card quickly limits your liability for unauthorized transactions.

To take any action (freeze, close, check credit cards, or block recurring payments) I’ll need to verify your identity first. Please tell me: 1) which action you want me to take right now (freeze both cards, freeze one, close both, etc.), and 2) pick any 2 of these to verify your identity: date of birth, email address on file, phone number on file, or your address. Once you confirm, I’ll proceed.

If you’d rather handle this yourself in the mobile app instead of verifying here, I can tell you where to go in the app — say the word and I’ll give those steps."}
